brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: accessory hex-acc-keyhole on the base (accessory:0#0,0#0) provides the keyhole hanger. Wall-face orientation is not verified by the configurator, and the rack is a single base block, not a multi-cell rack.

Two hex-acc-hook plates (accessory:0#0,0#2 and accessory:0#0,0#3) are fitted. Hand tools cannot be shown hanging on them as props; the configurator allows only cable coils, gaffer tape or FPV goggles on hooks, and the gaffer tape was refused as too low.

requirements.requirement: Built with house rules (open faces closed, joints locked)
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces applied (solid caps). lockJoints was refused as NO_CHANGE on this build; two faces remain capable of caps per the info check, which is advisory.

finish.summary: Built a single full hex base (piece 0,0,0) with a keyhole hanger on one face (accessory slot 0, for screws already in the wall), two hook plates on adjacent faces (slots 2 and 3) for small hand tools, and solid caps on the remaining open faces. Mesh check is clear and the rule check has no errors. Limits: the configurator cannot confirm which face is the wall face, so the keyhole's orientation was chosen by slot, not verified visually. Hand tools cannot be placed on hooks as props (only cable coils, gaffer tape or FPV goggles hang there), and a roll of gaffer tape was refused because the hooks sit too low to clear the bench, so the hooks are shown empty. The hook and keyhole are physical parts; no load rating or material suitability is claimed.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Hook plate
parts.use: Each plate carries two hooks side by side, so you bolt on as many as you want where you want them rather than committing a whole face to a rail.
